clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers stream through South Gate Outpost, a fortified post on the pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Its mountaineers guard the southern road between Ironforge's frigid heights and the Loch's temperate valley.

South Gate Outpost marks the frontier between Dun Morogh's snowy slopes and Loch Modan's basin. Ironforge mountaineers patrol the rocky switchbacks and keep dangerous wildlife off the main highway. Unlike their hard-pressed kin at North Gate Outpost, these defenders have largely secured their stretch of road. Travelers, pilgrims, and trade wagons can journey toward Thelsamar in relative safety.
